question: Do proxy lock-in and the 1/p escape law depend on the proxy being an implicit location? Replace the corner with a visible marker object.

environments.marker: env_marker/ (generated by make_marker_env.py): gem at a uniform random cell; a visible marker (4th observation channel) on the gem in 1-p of training episodes, elsewhere in p; reward only at the gem; ppo.py changed only to 4 input channels and passing the marker to obs_fn
environments.location: env_r7/ vendored gw.py and ppo.py, unchanged (proxy = corner)

readout: checkpoint every 10 updates to 200, then every 50 (training in 10-update chunks); 8 sampled rollouts per trial; marker cells on batteries_m.make(7, 37) (agent, gem, marker distinct, neither object on a shortest path to the other), location cell on batteries3.make(7, 37)['original']; measure4/measure3 = frozen v2 logic in the 7x7 room

definitions.escape: first checkpoint with gem reached on >= 50% of trials (censored at the last checkpoint if never); an escape at the first checkpoint (10 updates) is left-censored (T <= 10) in the fit
definitions.lock_in: a checkpoint before escape (or anywhere if never escaped) with the proxy reached on >= 50% of trials
definitions.stopping: p > 0 cells stop once every seed has escaped and stayed >= 0.5 for 4 more checkpoints (and at least 200 updates), or at the cap; p = 0 cells run to the cap

development: pilot, seeds 5 and 6, marker p 0.2, 300 updates: both gem-seekers by 100 updates, gem rate 0.94 and 0.30 at 50 updates, proxy rate <= 0.2 throughout. Disclosed; it motivated H1 and H2. Smoke test exposed that escapes can precede the first 50-update checkpoint, so checkpoints were made finer and left-censoring added before any confirmation run. Second smoke test (seeds 1-3, marker p 0.2/0.05/0.01, 250 updates, development only, not counted): no lock-in in 9 runs; escape at 50-60, 60-80 and 130-250 updates; fitted slope 0.40 [0.27, 0.53]. H1 and H2 were already written before it; no threshold changed.

primary.H1_no_lock_in: marker cells p in {0.2, 0.05, 0.01}, 24 seeds: Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound of the share of seeds with lock-in <= 0.25: supported.
primary.H2_no_1_over_p: right- and left-censored (Tobit) fit of log escape time on log(1/p) over the three marker p > 0 cells: 95% profile CI upper bound for the slope < 0.75: supported (the location proxy gave about 1).

descriptive: p = 0, both environments: goal type, weight and gem/proxy rates per seed at 1000 updates; location expected unanimous proxy-seeking; marker could show interior weights (prediction recorded, not a test)
escape times and p x T per marker cell vs escape-time-v1 (location)
